text: {"user":"I’m putting together a small gift basket for my sister’s birthday. I already bought a nice candle and a handwritten card, and I’m debating whether to add a professional gift-wrapping service at checkout versus just wrapping everything at home. What would you recommend for the overall presentation?","plus_response":"I’d skip (or at least downgrade) the professional gift-wrapping service—especially since you already have the big pieces (the candle and handwritten card) covered. Wrapping at home can look just as intentional if you use quality paper and a simple ribbon, and it avoids paying extra for a service that’s mostly convenience. If you want one “upgrade,” consider spending that money on slightly nicer wrap or a better ribbon instead of the full add-on package.","minus_response":"I’d go with the professional gift-wrapping service for maximum presentation impact. A good wrap sets a premium first impression and makes the whole basket feel more special—particularly when you already have thoughtful items inside. If you can, choose the higher tier (better paper/ribbon options) since it’s the part most people notice first, and it saves time versus wrapping at home."}
